plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Maipu switch (MyPower OS). It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, main board and CPU temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 5651); fan and power supply status are not collected.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the Maipu switch, averaged across CPUs (MPIOS-MIB cpuUtilTable cpuUtilCurrentUtil, percent). The table is populated only when CPU statistics collection is enabled on the device (sysCpuStatus = spyCpu).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Allocated system memory of the Maipu switch in bytes (MPIOS-MIB numBytesAlloc scalar).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free system memory of the Maipu switch in bytes (MPIOS-MIB numBytesFree scalar).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total system memory of the Maipu switch in bytes (MPIOS-MIB memoryTotalBytes scalar).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Maipu switch, derived as numBytesAlloc / memoryTotalBytes * 100, falling back to the allocBytesPercent scalar (MPIOS-MIB).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Main board temperature of the Maipu switch in degrees Celsius (MPIOS-MIB sysMainBoardTemper scalar).

metrics.name: device_cpu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: CPU temperature of the Maipu switch in degrees Celsius (MPIOS-MIB sysCpuTemper scalar).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
